// diagnostic E0074

Jet.CollectingLoopItemMismatch

This collecting loop produces incompatible item types.

What

This collecting loop produces incompatible item types.

Why

One collecting loop builds one `[T]`, so every contributed item must have the same type.

Fix

Convert the items to one type, or split the operations into separate loops.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.CollectingLoopItemMismatch: Tests/UI/yielding_loop_item_mismatch.stderr.

Error: Jet.CollectingLoopItemMismatch: This collecting loop produces incompatible item types
  --> Tests/UI/yielding_loop_item_mismatch.jet:2:36
    |
  2 |     values: loop item in [1, 2] -> if item == 1 -> item else -> "two"
    |                                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: One collecting loop builds one List, but these paths produce Int (a whole number) and String (text)
 Fix: Convert every item to one type, or split the loops
